question: Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bs.over_id,
        bs.innings_no,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bs.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = er.ball_id
        AND bs.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bs.match_id, bs.over_id, bs.innings_no
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, MAX(total_runs) as max_over_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no
),
max_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.over_id, o.innings_no, o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.innings_no = m.innings_no
    WHERE o.total_runs = m.max_over_runs
),
bowler_runs_in_over AS (
    SELECT 
        mo.match_id,
        mo.over_id,
        mo.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as bowler_runs_in_that_over
    FROM max_overs mo
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON mo.match_id = b.match_id 
        AND mo.over_id = b.over_id
        AND mo.innings_no = b.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY mo.match_id, mo.over_id, mo.innings_no, b.bowler
),
bowler_max_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        MAX(bowler_runs_in_that_over) as max_runs_in_max_over
    FROM bowler_runs_in_over
    GROUP BY bowler
),
top3_bowlers AS (
    SELECT bowler, max_runs_in_max_over
    FROM bowler_max_stats
    ORDER BY max_runs_in_max_over DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
bowler_with_match AS (
    SELECT 
        t3.bowler,
        t3.max_runs_in_max_over,
        brm.match_id,
        brm.over_id
    FROM top3_bowlers t3
    JOIN bowler_runs_in_over brm ON t3.bowler = brm.bowler 
        AND brm.bowler_runs_in_that_over = t3.max_runs_in_max_over
)
SELECT 
    bm.bowler,
    bm.max_runs_in_max_over,
    bm.match_id,
    bm.over_id,
    p.player_name
FROM bowler_with_match bm
JOIN player p ON bm.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bm.max_runs_in_max_over DESC
